quotes.text:
only-for-build-platforms:
    - linux64-shippable/opt  # ATN only support 1 platform per locale. That's why we use linux64
    - macosx64-shippable/opt  # Although, we need the special locale "ja-JP-Mac" from this platform

channel:
                by-project:
                    comm-(beta|release|esr.*):
                        by-platform:
                            # ja-JP-mac is only langpack on mac, and is unlisted always
                            macosx64.*: unlisted
                            default: listed
                    default: unlisted

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The language-pack task uses linux64 for the normal per-locale upload and macosx64 for ja-JP-Mac. Even on beta, release or ESR projects, the macOS branch is unlisted, while the default platform branch is listed. For this mapping, adding a release project must retain the nested platform exception. The comment and mapping are source evidence; actual add-on service publication was not run. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Preserve the macOS language-pack exception inside release routing
